공통.장르: cinematic studio footage for a luxury men's cologne commercial

누구.TAEJUN: the same Korean man as in the first frame, in every frame — early thirties, lean athletic build, bare-chested with no shirt, plain black trousers, jet-black medium-length hair swept back with a few loose strands over the brow, light stubble; no jewelry, no watch, no sunglasses, no tattoos. He never speaks or sings: lips closed, a calm neutral face, no smile.
누구.BOTTLE: the cologne bottle exactly as in the first frame — a square bottle of thick blue glass with a square brushed-silver cap and white print on the front: the mark ㅅ, the name 솔서리, SOLSEORI, EAU DE COLOGNE and 100 ml. Its shape and print stay exactly the same in every frame — never warped, blurred into new letters or rewritten.
누구.ICE SCULPTURE: the carved clear-ice ㅅ sculpture from the first frame — an upright Λ of two thick legs of crystal-clear wet ice joined at a ridge at the top, with faint fractures and tiny bubbles inside. It keeps exactly this shape and never becomes a Y: no stem, post or third leg anywhere.
누구.PINE: Korean red pine needles — long, thin needles growing in pairs from a small brown sheath, dark blue-green under the blue light.
누구.FROST: fine granular white rime frost — tiny dry ice grains like sugar crystals along every needle; no snowflake or star shapes, no round water drops. The frost does not melt, grow or fall.

공통.보기: LOOK: one cold cobalt-blue world from the first frame to the last — saturated cobalt light, deep navy shadows, cold blue-white highlights on edges; keep the first frame's colors, brightness, contrast and white balance to the very end; real cinema-camera footage with natural motion blur, no CGI look, no beauty filter; no added text, letters, logos or watermarks (any lettering already in the first frame stays exactly as it is), no extra people.
공통.소리: SOUND: silent clip — no dialogue, no narration, no music.

판.설명: 어두운 무대 — 빛줄기 셋 아래 태준 실루엣이 카메라 쪽으로 또박또박 걸어 나옴(고정)

샷.동작: On the dark, empty stage, Taejun — a near-silhouette, only his outline rim-lit by the beams, face and body in shadow, no facial detail readable — walks straight toward the camera with steady, deliberate steps: three to four steps in about 2 s, growing to about 1.2x his first-frame size while staying at the same spot across the frame (a little right of centre). The three wide diagonal beams of cold light behind him drift slowly and breathe — bright at first, dimmest around 1.0–1.2 s, bright again by 2 s (about ±10%). The thin glowing stage-edge line stays put and the floor below it stays pure black, with no reflections.
샷.카메라: locked off on a tripod — no movement, no zoom, no shake; the stage-edge line and his place across the frame stay exactly where they are from start to end; only he and the light move.

판.설명: 등 뒤 어깨 너머 — 팔을 빛 쪽으로 올리며 손을 폄 → 낮은 각도 정면, 팔 벌리고 고개 젖힌 태준이 팔을 휘두르며 다가옴(두 샷 묶음)

샷.동작: Very close from just behind his bare right shoulder: the rounded shoulder fills the left half of the frame, and his right arm already reaches forward below shoulder height with a loose fist from the first frame. Within about 0.8 s he raises the arm toward the bright light at the upper right and opens his hand, fingers spreading; his shoulder and upper back turn a little with the arm, changing the shoulder's shape. Only the edge of his black hair shows at the top left — his face never comes into view.
샷.카메라: locked off — no movement, no zoom, no shake; the far lights and floor line in the background stay exactly in place; only his arm and shoulder move.

샷.동작: Low angle from the front: Taejun already stands with both arms spread wide to the sides, hands half open, head tilted back, eyes closed, face up into the hazy light pouring down from above, and holds it for about 0.6 s after the cut; then, about 0.65 s after the cut, he swings both arms up fast and surges toward the camera, the arms blurring with motion by about 1 s after the cut. Lips closed.
샷.카메라: low angle in front of him, pushing in slowly and steadily from the cut while he moves toward it, so his body grows to about 1.5x its size by about 1 s after the cut; the last 0.3 s carries motion blur from his fast arm swing; no camera shake.

판.설명: 세운 「ㅅ」 얼음 — 등마루에서 갈라져 두 다리 앞면으로 흐르는 물막 → 얼음벽 사이 물보라가 솟아 렌즈를 덮음(두 샷 묶음)

샷.동작: Low and very close in front of the ice sculpture — its ridge at the very top of the frame, its two thick legs sloping down to the lower left and lower right: clear water is already pouring onto the ridge from the first frame, splitting there and running down the front faces of both legs as wide, glassy sheets, with droplets splashing up in the middle of the frame. The ice itself does not move.
샷.카메라: a slight push-in to about 1.03x while the camera sinks a little so the ice moves up about 5% of the frame height; fast at first and easing to almost still within about 0.5 s; only a very slight tremor.

샷.동작: At water level between two walls of clear ice, the crown of splash in the middle is already rising out of the churning water; about 0.6 s after the cut it surges forward straight at the lens, the water hits and covers the lens, and by about 0.75 s after the cut the whole frame is filled with rushing water.
샷.카메라: locked off — no movement, no zoom, no shake; only the water moves, rushing at the lens.

판.설명: 얼음 덩이 속 솔잎 — 가로 금을 따라 물이 반짝, 1.13배 다가가며 얼음이 오른쪽 아래로 점점 빨리 미끄러짐

샷.동작: Inside the tall block of clear ice, the frozen pine needles and tiny bubbles stay fixed in the ice; water already seeps along the horizontal crack across the middle from the first frame and keeps glistening there, a few bright drops running along it. 샷.카메라: a steady push-in to about 1.13x over about 0.85 s while the ice block slides toward the lower right of the frame — about 9% right and 7% down by 0.85 s — slow at first and faster and faster (the camera drifts up and to the left); no easing at the end, no shake.
